test_title: PYST 49: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 07 Mar, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: P got 20 percent less marks than Q. R got 20 percent less marks than Q. If R got 160 marks, then what are the marks of P?
solution:
**Given:**

P got 20 percent less marks than Q.

R got 20 percent less marks than Q.

R got 160 marks.

**Formula Used:**

Marks of P = Marks of Q - 20% of Marks of Q

**Calculation:**

Let marks of Q be Q.

According to the given data:

R = Q - 0.2Q

160 = 0.8Q

⇒ Q = 160 / 0.8

⇒ Q = 200

Marks of P:

P = Q - 0.2Q

P = 200 - 0.2 × 200

P = 200 - 40

⇒ P = 160

**The marks of P are 160.**
